caption:
An NRI in Saudi Arabia just gave his hometown a free ambulance. In memory of his mother.

Raja Sood, an NRI based in Riyadh, donated an ambulance to the Palampur Sani Sewa Sadan in Himachal Pradesh, in memory of his late mother Chanchala Devi Sood. The Palampur Municipal Corporation's commissioner flagged off the vehicle, equipped with a basic life-support system, which will serve the poor free of cost. Sood himself could not attend the handover ceremony.

He couldn't be there in person for the ceremony. The ambulance will be there for his hometown, long after he's gone back to Riyadh.

Source: single Tribune report - independent confirmation not found; treat specifics as preliminary.
